facts.label: Didn’t no passado
facts.sub: Use didn’t para negar no passado: it didn’t arrive, I didn’t see it, the driver didn’t leave a note. Depois de didn’t, o verbo fica sem -ed. Pergunte Did you ask?

facts.label: Encomenda perdida
facts.sub: Se a encomenda não chegar, tenha o código de rastreio à mão. Explique o problema de forma simples: My package didn’t arrive. Atendentes costumam consultar o sistema e orientar os próximos passos.

facts.label: Rastreio
facts.sub: Use tracking number para o código. O site mostra status como shipped, out for delivery e delivered. Se o status disser delivered e você não recebeu, procure em volta e pergunte aos vizinhos.

pages.title: A small post office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday afternoon in a small post office in Portland. A line of people waits with boxes and letters. Tom stands at the counter with his phone. A clerk named Gina smiles at him. He looks a little worried. He explains his problem.
“Good afternoon. How can I help you?” says Gina. “My package didn’t arrive. I ordered it last week.” says Tom. “Did you get a tracking number?” says Gina.
